response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), s AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share FROM c) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS share_above_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Districts are only those that appear in account.district_id (districts with zero accounts are excluded from the average share), so the average share is 1 divided by the number of districts with accounts.
Ties at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.

alternatives.interpretation: Average share taken across all districts in the district table, including those with zero accounts (their share is 0).
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id), s AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share FROM c) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS share_above_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
